schemeTitle: Solar Power Scheme for PVTGs (under PM-JANMAN)

claims.claim: Notified in January 2024 under PM-JANMAN by Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) with ₹515 Crore outlay (2023-24 to 2025-26).
claims.sourceTitle: Operational Guidelines for New Solar Power Scheme for PVTGs under PM-JANMAN
claims.sourcePublisher: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
claims.evidenceQuote: MNRE notified the New Solar Power Scheme for Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs) habitations and villages under PM-JANMAN with an approved financial outlay of Rs. 515 Crore for 2023-24 to 2025-26.
claims.notes: MNRE notification and ₹515 Cr outlay confirmed.

claims.claim: Electrifies 1,00,000 un-electrified households (0.3 kW SHLS / ₹50,000 per HH) across 18 States and UT of Andaman & Nicobar.
claims.sourceTitle: Solarization of PVTG Habitations under PM-JANMAN
claims.evidenceQuote: The scheme covers 1 lakh un-electrified households in PVTG areas across 18 states and UT of Andaman & Nicobar Islands through 0.3 kW off-grid solar home lighting systems with financial assistance of Rs. 50,000 per household.
claims.notes: Target count, 0.3 kW capacity, and 18 states confirmed.

claims.claim: Solarises 1,500 Multi-Purpose Centres (MPCs) with 2.5 kW Solar PV packs (₹1.00 Lakh per centre).
claims.sourceTitle: Guidelines on Solar Power for PVTGs
claims.sourcePublisher: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
claims.evidenceQuote: Solarisation of 1,500 Multi-Purpose Centres (MPCs) with 2.5 kW Solar PV power packs with battery storage with Central Financial Assistance of Rs. 1 Lakh per MPC.

claims.claim: Includes 5 years of comprehensive free maintenance.
claims.sourceTitle: Guidelines on Solar Power for PVTGs
claims.sourcePublisher: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
claims.evidenceQuote: System installations include 5 years of comprehensive maintenance by the implementing agencies.

crossSchemeRelationship: The Solar Power Scheme for PVTGs is MNRE's dedicated component under the broader multi-ministry PM-JANMAN mission.
examTrapVerified: Confirmed: Nodal ministry is MNRE; individual systems are 0.3 kW; MPC systems are 2.5 kW.
